117734.name: Chabad of Virginia
117734.note: CrownHeights.info (9 Sept 2011): 'Rabbi Yossel Kranz, executive director of Chabad of the Virginias, whose father founded the center in 1976 at the direction of the Rebbe'; his father, Rabbi Yaakov Noach Kranz, 'who directed Chabad-Lubavitch activities in the state for 15 years'. Lubavitch.com (30 Nov 2014): the Richmond center was 'Founded by Rabbi Yaakov Noach Kranz, of blessed memory and his wife Fay'. Now 212 Gaskins Road.

117733.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Northern Virginia
117733.note: Lubavitch.com (on CrownHeights.info, 17 June 2007): 'When Chabad of Northern Virginia celebrated their 16th anniversary with a black-tie dinner and concert'; 'During the last sixteen years, Chabad has made deep inroads into the Northern Virginia communities' (Rabbi Sholom Deitsch, director). Medium: counted back (about 1991). Now 3939 Prince William Drive, Fairfax.

118496.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Alexandria-Arlington
118496.note: CrownHeights.info (7 June 2007): Chabad Lubavitch of Alexandria-Arlington celebrated 'Five Incredible Years'; 'Since its inception in 2001 under the direction of Rabbi Mordechai and Yehudis Newman'. Lubavitch.com (17 June 2007) calls it a satellite of Chabad of Northern Virginia. Now 1307 N Highland Street, Arlington.

118528.name: Rohr Chabad House at The University of Virginia
118528.note: Lubavitch.com (2 Aug 2002, 'New Center in Charlottesville'): 'Rabbi Shlomo and Chana Mayer arrived to this campus town, home to the University of Virginia and some 500 Jewish families, last January'; they had led High Holiday services there 'back in September', and Rabbi Yossel Kranz asked them back 'to establish a permanent Chabad presence there'. Rabbi Reuvi Mayer is on the listing now.

565251.name: Chabad at Virginia Tech, Librescu Center
565251.note: Lubavitch.com (15 July 2007): Rabbi Elazar and Rivkah Bloom will head 'the new Chabad House opening next month at Virginia Tech'; after the shooting of April 2007, in which Prof. Liviu Librescu was killed, 'Rabbi Kranz pledged to open a Chabad center on campus'. Its chabad.org listing went up Sept 16 2007. Now 301 Wall Street, Blacksburg (Rabbi Zwiebel).
